full_prompt_en: A square low-light city photograph shows a lone dark silhouette on a raised walkway overlooking a town almost erased by low fog. The upper half is an expanse of deep charcoal and green-black night, with no clear horizon line. In the middle distance, a broad coral-red glow swells through the mist. A line of small red lights curves across the lower part of that glow, and two taller structures or towers appear as faint vertical patterns with scattered windows inside it. Their edges dissolve before reaching the surrounding darkness. The foreground is much darker: rooflines and a metal railing cut a low jagged band across the bottom and middle, but the walkway surface is barely visible. At right-center, one person stands upright beside the railing, small enough to read chiefly as a black shape against the lighter fog. A few cool white or cyan points sit near the silhouette and along the left side, giving a restrained color contrast with the distant red. A dark wall or tree mass closes the far right edge. The fog does most of the spatial work, veiling buildings and allowing only lights and a few vertical forms to suggest the city below. There is little surface detail in the near shadow, while tiny window specks appear in the distance. Light comes from the diffused red city sources, spreading outward as a soft atmospheric halo without a sharp beam; the small cooler points remain local. The overall composition is hushed and ominous, balancing a large dark foreground with a single small watcher and a glowing, half-hidden urban depth.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形低光城市照片描绘一名深暗剪影站在高起的步道上，俯望一座几乎被低雾抹去的城镇。上半幅是深炭色与绿黑色夜空，没有清楚地平线。中远处一团宽阔珊瑚红光晕在雾中胀开，一列小红灯沿这团亮雾的下部弯曲延伸，两座较高建筑或塔楼以散着窗灯的淡竖线浮现其中。它们的边缘在接触周围黑暗前已经消失。前景更深暗：屋脊与金属栏杆横切下方和中部，形成低低的参差色带，步道表面几乎不可见。中右部一人直立于栏杆旁，体量小到主要作为浅雾前的黑色形状辨认。几处冷白或青色光点停在人物附近与左侧，为远方红色提供克制的色彩对照。最右缘由深墙或树团收住。雾气承担大部分空间表达，遮盖建筑，只让灯光和少数竖形暗示下方城市。近处暗影里表面细节很少，远处则出现微小窗灯颗粒。光来自被雾漫射的红色城市灯源，以柔和空气光晕向外扩散，没有清晰光束；较冷的小亮点保持局部。整体构图静寂而不祥，以大片深暗前景平衡一名小小观看者和发光却半隐藏的城市纵深。
style_prompt_en: A low-hanging-fog photographic treatment holds most of the frame in deep green-black and charcoal, letting a limited cluster of colored light bloom through obscured middle distance. Strong near silhouettes form a low dark band, while background structures lose edges and become faint vertical suggestions. A coral or muted red glow occupies a wider hazy area than its small individual sources, with sparse cool points providing countercolor. Negative dark space above and below makes the glowing zone feel isolated and distant. Light is scattered by dense moisture, so it has a soft halo rather than a crisp beam or clearly cast shadow. Fine luminous specks register depth where surfaces themselves cannot be seen. The overall effect is quiet, tense, and spatially uncertain, using illumination and edge loss to reveal only fragments of a larger scene.
style_prompt_zh: 低垂雾气的摄影处理让画面大部分留在深绿黑与炭色中，仅让有限的彩光簇从被遮蔽的中远处晕开。强烈近景剪影形成低暗色带，背景结构则失去边缘，化为淡淡竖向暗示。珊瑚或暗红光晕占据比小型单独光源更宽的雾区，稀疏冷色亮点提供对照。上下深暗负空间让发光区域显得孤立遥远。密集水汽散射光线，因此它呈柔和光晕，而非清晰束光或明确投影。细小发亮颗粒在看不清实体表面的地方登记纵深。整体安静、紧张且空间不确定，借光与边缘消失只揭示更大场景的一些片段。
theme_en: A lone silhouette on a dark walkway overlooking a fogbound city of red lights
theme_zh: 一人剪影站在暗道上，俯望被低雾笼罩的红灯城市
name: Low-hanging fog
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
